steps.title: Make the intention
steps.instruction: Intend in your heart to purify yourself for prayer.

ruling.english: It is recommended that the one making wudu intends purification.

ruling.arabic: وتسمية الله تعالى في ابتداء الوضوء
ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: naming Allah at the start of wudu.

steps.title: Wash the hands
steps.instruction: Wash both hands first, before they go into the water. This is a sunnah for one who has just woken from sleep.

ruling.arabic: وغسل اليدين قبل إدخالها إذا استيقظ المتوضئ من نومه
ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: washing the hands before putting them in, when the one making wudu has woken from sleep.

steps.title: Clean the teeth
steps.instruction: Clean your teeth with the siwak.

ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: the siwak, rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose.
Among the sunnahs of purification: the siwak, rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose.

steps.title: Sniff water into the nose
steps.instruction: Sniff a little water into your nose.

ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: the siwak, rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose.

steps.title: Wash the face
steps.instruction: Wash your whole face. This is an obligation of wudu.

steps.title: Wash the arms
steps.instruction: Wash your arms up to the elbows, elbows included. This is an obligation of wudu.

ruling.english: The elbows and the ankles are included in the washing.

steps.title: Wipe the head
steps.instruction: Wipe your head with wet hands. Al-Quduri makes the amount of the forelock the obligation.

ruling.arabic: والمفروض في مسح الرأس مقدار الناصية
ruling.english: What is obligatory in wiping the head is the amount of the forelock.
Among the sunnahs of purification: wiping the ears.

steps.title: Wash the feet
steps.instruction: Wash your feet up to the ankles, ankles included. This is an obligation of wudu.

ruling.english: and your feet up to the ankles.

steps.title: Between the fingers
steps.instruction: Run wet fingers between your fingers, and through the beard if you have one.

ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: combing the beard and the fingers with water.

steps.title: Three times
steps.instruction: Wash each limb up to three times.

ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: repeating the washing up to three times.

steps.title: Keep the order
steps.instruction: Wash in the order Allah names them, and begin with the right side.

ruling.arabic: ويرتب الوضوء فيبدأ بما بدأ الله تعالى بذكره وبالميامن
ruling.english: He keeps the wudu in order, beginning with what Allah mentioned first, and with the right side.

steps.title: After wudu
steps.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ
steps.meaning: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is Allah's servant and messenger.

ruling.arabic: مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ يَتَوَضَّأُ فَيُبْلِغُ - أَوْ فَيُسْبِغُ - الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ إِلاَّ فُتِحَتْ لَهُ أَبْوَابُ الْجَنَّةِ الثَّمَانِيَةُ يَدْخُلُ مِنْ أَيِّهَا شَاءَ
ruling.english: If any of you performs wudu well and then says: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger, the eight gates of Paradise are opened for him, and he may enter by whichever he wishes.
